unique_value: sensor voting authority changes with observed peer health rather than remaining static
correlated reporters share one fault-domain quorum weight instead of multiplying authority by count
below-threshold sensors are suspended instead of silently trusted
reinstatement requires independent domains and multiple distinct healthy recovery rounds
health decisions expose domain weights, suspension transitions, recovery state, and reasons

capability_contribution.ownership: This repository remains the owning Anduril-specialist implementation; extraction preserves identity and lineage.

next_evolution: Authenticate fault-domain and recovery-round attestations, expire stale peer evidence, and chain health decisions to durable append-only receipts without weakening correlation-aware suspension/recovery semantics.
nonclaims: not a production sensor-fusion control service
fault_domain and round_id are caller-supplied evidence labels and are not externally authenticated
peer evidence does not yet expire automatically
decision receipts are not yet durably chained
